items.title: Dawoud Sabu Adeyola interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 30, 2025
items.q: Yes, yes. I do. It was from a man named Elvin Shepherd.

ctx.x: Do you remember the first time you got paid to play your bass?
Yes, yes. I do. It was from a man named Elvin Shepherd. You know about Elvin Shepherd?
I see his name on your promo material.
